permitted_claims: Under SharedLearnerV1 and the frozen S1 apparatus, S->B backbone scaling did not materially improve downstream accessibility at PRIMARY_32768.

observations: local DINO field remains 37x37, so it is incorrect to say all DINO information is reduced to 16x16
cross-view context is pooled to 16x16 then bilinearly upsampled
all candidate token widths enter one shared 1536->256 stem
native-1024 detail access is a sparse 25-RGBA-sample stencil encoded by a small MLP, not a dense learned high-resolution spatial field
the final query head is pointwise after sampling the shared encoded field
the frozen objective is uniform mean SmoothL1(beta=0.01), with no direct tail/derivative/consumer-aligned term
reason.summary: A code-level audit after S/B results identified a material shared accessibility ceiling/confound in the fixed learner/loss/access path, reducing the scientific value of spending the remaining compute on L/g under the same apparatus.
